pages.text: Hello! You might be thinking about how do you get the phone, the computer and all that Digitech stuff (on Minecraft ;) Before anything else, you would need two new minerals of this mod: plastic and microchip.

Plastic can be found in high layers and mined with a stone pickaxe, and it's awesomely common; while microchips appear between layers -20 and -64 and require an iron pickaxe. These minerals are essential for crafting most Digitech items and blocks, so getting them is your first step into the tech world!
I let you here the recipe of a microchip block (for filling space ;)
